name: Danja (Floyd Nathaniel Hills)
sources: style-research-extended-2 vol.2 rnb-2000s — Danja (Floyd Nathaniel Hills)
notes: Timbaland's co-producer turned solo electro-R&B architect, 2004–2011. Tempo is "100–115 straight, with a four-on-the-floor-adjacent kick from 2007", mode 113 — the sourced reading, in F♯ minor. Three drum deltas: "Timbaland-derived displacement — kick clusters on 16ths" (four to six hits a bar at 0.62 syncopation), "snare pushed off the backbeat" (a 5–12 ms push against the parent's 1–4), and "clicky non-hat percussion" as a five-lane perc/perc2/woodblock/rim/cowbell bed at −4 dB with the hat lane itself cut to 0.24 and non-continuous — this board's 16th motion is percussion, not hats. "Hardened with an electro/'disco-ish' four-on-the-floor kick and a gated clap on 2&4 from 2006 on" is the kick's downbeat anchors on 1 and 3 with `fourOnFloorInChorus` and a clap stack. The identifying parameter is the low end and the entry names it: "'low electronic lines' — a saturated synth-bass riff in 8ths or 16ths that doubles as the melodic hook, rather than a sustained 808". So `rhythm` is `offbeat_8ths`, `followRootsProb` is 0.44 — the lowest of the producers here after Huff and Jam & Lewis — and the cells are real riffs; there is no `bass808` block, deliberately, because the research says this is not a sustained 808. Harmony is "two-chord minor vamps with buzzing detuned synth leads; the bass and lead synth carry all the harmony, pads minimal", so `maxChords` is 2 with a triad-leaning spread and the counter is an `arp`-led synth line at a 0.54 density. "Melodies built from short repeated cells" and the speak-sing outro are the riff contour, `twoBarCellRepeat` and the staccato articulation. ⚠ The research notes the released master "sits a quarter-tone sharp, a detail worth modelling as deliberate detune"; the schema has no master-tuning field, so that is recorded here rather than encoded. ⚠ Every velocity and density number is INFERRED. ⚠ `session.keys` is part-sourced: the entry names `F#m`, and the remaining values `Cm`, `Bm`, `Gm`, together with all 4 weights, are INFERRED rather than read from the entry. ⚠ **`chords.harmonicRhythm` re-weighted (2026-08-17, harmony variety floor).** The entry's harmony line is "two-chord minor vamps with buzzing detuned synth leads; the bass and lead synth carry all the harmony, pads minimal", and the engine's `vamp` value is *one* chord held for the whole clip (`generators::chords`: "One chord for the whole pattern") — so weighting `vamp` at the top rendered a **one**-chord bed the research nowhere describes. The chord motion the entry states is now carried by `1_per_bar` (the pair over a 2-bar cell) and `2_bars_per_chord` (the pair over a 4-bar cell), with `vamp` kept as the minority for the held reading. ⚠ The split between those two rates is **INFERRED** — the entry names the device, not its rate.
